dependency.title: Dependency support
dependency.subtitle: We guide you through the process of applying for the dependency financial benefit.
dependency.intro: If you have been granted a level of dependency and want to apply for a financial benefit, you don't have to do it alone. We help you with the paperwork.

help.title: We help you with the paperwork

grade.title: You have a recognised level of dependency
grade.text: This is the starting point for applying for the dependency financial benefit.

guidance.title: We guide and support you
guidance.text: We explain what needs to be done and help you complete the procedures.

social.title: Processed through social services
social.text: The procedures are carried out through the social services of your neighbourhood or municipality.

services.title: Services provided by our caregivers
services.intro: Daily care and support, adapted to each person's needs:

hygiene.title: Full personal hygiene
hygiene.text: Daily washing and personal care, with respect and attention.

medication.title: Medication management
medication.text: Supervising medication intake according to the prescribed schedule.

mobility.title: Mobility assistance
mobility.text: Getting up and into bed, transfers from bed to chair, etc.

company.title: Companionship, supervision and walks
company.text: Presence, attention and outings so the person feels accompanied and safe.

home.title: Home maintenance
home.text: Making beds, shopping, preparing meals, general housecleaning, deep cleaning, etc.

cta.title: Questions about dependency?
cta.text: Tell us about your case and we will advise you with no obligation.
